rules: Project clean architecture: entrypoints compose and render; application uses explicit ports and core records, never imports logging or adapters.

modules.responsibility: Compose queue operations and render worker diagnostics.
modules.interface: Existing CLI stdout contracts retained; worker stderr INFO default with level control.
modules.effects: Own stderr and signal rendering; queue effects remain adapters.

modules.responsibility: Schedule queue work through explicit ports and publish optional observation snapshots.
modules.interface: worker(stop, poll_seconds=1, *, observe=None); existing callers remain valid.
modules.effects: Effects through injected ports and optional callback only.

contracts.rules: Application/core exclude logging and effects; entrypoint SDK ownership and layer directions are enforced.
Injected forbidden logging and adapter edges fail; initializers remain inert and dynamic targets obey boundaries.

checks.expectation: Actual graph and injected forbidden-edge cases pass.

checks.command: uv run --frozen --no-sync pytest tests/test_queue_logging.py tests/test_queue_commands.py tests/test_shared_queue_service.py
checks.expectation: Default real worker emits diagnostics; level filtering, stdout, transitions and observer compatibility pass.

checks.command: Markdown lint, local-link checks and cy-queue worker --help
checks.expectation: Changed docs and linked references validate; log-level examples match actual parser.

documentation: Update docs/queue.md and README.md, plus companion corp-skills usage/evaluation references; preserve historical specs.

review.reviewer: Independent /root/final_review; parent resolved record-only redaction dependency detail.
review.reconciliation: Compared all task-owned tracked and untracked diff: two source modules, regression tests, README, queue guide, bug artifacts and generated changelog. No other changes in this checkout; original main checkout concurrent compatibility work and local overrides excluded. Companion portable skill changes reviewed separately. Final release reconciliation: reviewed queue source/tests remained byte-identical after rebasing onto v0.30.0; native release changes only root version tokens and generated changelog. Concurrent specs/032 delivery documentation was merged intact; its compatibility implementation is baseline, not logging scope.
